train.via: Tel Aviv Center to Yerushalayim/Yits'hak Navon

bus.via: Tel Aviv-Savidor Train Stations/Platforms B to Jerusalem Central Bus Station/Alight

trips.route_note: Frequent Israel Railways trains run from Tel Aviv stations (Hashalom, Savidor) to Jerusalem Yitzhak Navon station in about 40 minutes, then take the light rail or a short bus ride into the Old City.
trips.tour_query: Jerusalem day trip from Tel Aviv
trips.why: Frequent trains take about 47 minutes and drop you at Navon station with light rail into the Old City.
know: Many sights close on Saturdays and Jewish holidays, so check opening hours
Book popular sites like the Old City tunnels ahead in peak season
Spring and autumn are the most comfortable seasons to walk the Old City

train.via: Tel Aviv Center to Haifa Center

bus.via: Tel Aviv Train Station Savidor/Namir Road to Hof HaKarmel Central Station/Alight

trips.route_note: Direct Israel Railways trains from Tel Aviv Savidor or Hashalom reach Haifa's Merkaz/Hashmona stations in under an hour; the Carmelit funicular or local buses connect to the Bahai Gardens and German Colony.
trips.tour_query: Haifa and Bahai Gardens day trip from Tel Aviv
trips.why: Direct trains reach Haifa in about 1h 9m, faster and more frequent than the bus.
know: Bahai Gardens terraces have limited visiting hours and some sections need a guided tour
The Carmelit funicular is useful for the steep climb to the gardens
Clear spring and autumn days give the best views over the bay

problems: Beit Shemesh: no Omio position, dropped
